name: CardChain AI
description: Real trading card market data directly in Claude. Ask about any card and get live pricing with 30-day history, population reports across graders, and ROI analysis. See your whole collection's value at a glance, check how a player's season is shaping card demand, and browse cards for sale — all without leaving chat. Built for collectors who care about making the right call before they buy, sell, or grade.

_published_faq.name: How do I add CardChain AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add CardChain AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.cardchain.ai/mcp/claude. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the CardChain AI MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: CardChain AI provides these MCP tools: search_cards, get_card_price, find_card_for_grading, should_i_grade, find_card_to_add, add_to_portfolio, get_portfolio, get_population, get_player_stats, get_cardchain_listings, and get_capabilities.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to CardChain AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to CardChain AI in media on the Manufact MCP catalog include FreqBlog Music Metadata, Futrumi, KinElo, QuizHP, and Wistia.

_published_faq.name: Does CardChain AI MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: CardChain AI requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
CardChain AI is developed by CardChain, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
